text: Bought the Aurora X2. Pretty blown away for sure. Sound quality is exceptional. Deep bass but not bloated. Crispy highs. The ANC works really really well, blocked out all noise. Really impressive, good for commuting. Battery life really surprising, nearly 30 hours. So I'd recommend. Not a single bad thing about it? Well, comfort could've been better. The cushions make my ears hot. The app is flakey, will disconnect randomly. For $149, I'd suggest these as my everyday headphones.
